summary: Bragg Gaming Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K exhibiting a Share Purchase Agreement dated July 13, 2026, to acquire all issued shares of Drayton International, a Cayman Islands entity, from Tekkorp entities and other sellers. Consideration is in Bragg shares, making Drayton a wholly-owned subsidiary. The agreement includes a Standstill and Voting Agreement dated July 22, 2026, and lock-up provisions. Regulatory approvals are mutual conditions precedent. Specific price per share, premium, and dollar value are not disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and closing mechanics under Canadian and multi-jurisdictional law.
